chunks: And with this chain, from Jabir, from Abi al-Tufayl, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:

There is no Muslim servant who says 'La ilaha illallah' except that [the declaration] ascends, piercing every roof, passing through nothing of his bad deeds except it covers them, until it reaches an equal number of good deeds and then stops.

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: The declaration of monotheism (La ilaha illallah)

ai.seo_question: What happens to a Muslim's sins when they recite La ilaha illallah?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to highlight the metaphysical efficacy of the *Tawhid* declaration, portraying it as a dynamic force that ascends through the celestial layers. It illustrates the principle of *kaffarat al-khaba'ith* (expiation of minor sins), where the utterance neutralizes corresponding misdeeds, thereby purifying the soul and preparing it for divine proximity.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 7. And from the previous chain from Jabir from Abi al-Tufayl from Ali (a.s.)

who said: ‘There is no God except Allah’ and his or her grades are not elevated. He or she will continue to scale all heights. None of his (or her) sins shall be questioned. And for each of his sins equal number of good deeds would be given and he would be satisfied.
